entries.title: Psalms 92:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath.> It is a good thing to give praise to the Lord, and to make melody to your name, O Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 92:2
segments: To make clear your mercy in the morning, and your unchanging faith every night;

entries.title: Psalms 92:3
segments: On a ten-corded instrument, and on an instrument of music with a quiet sound.

entries.title: Psalms 92:4
segments: For you, O Lord, have made me glad through your work; I will have joy in the works of your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 92:5
segments: O Lord, how great are your works! and your thoughts are very deep.

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
segments: A man without sense has no knowledge of this; and a foolish man may not take it in.

entries.title: Psalms 92:7
segments: ¶When the sinners come up like the grass, and all the workers of evil do well for themselves, it is so that their end may be eternal destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 92:8
segments: But you, O Lord, are on high for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 92:9
segments: For see! your haters, O Lord, will be put to death; all the workers of evil will be put to flight;

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
segments: But my horn is lifted up like the horn of the ox: the best oil is flowing on my head.

entries.title: Psalms 92:11
segments: My eyes have seen trouble come on my haters; my ears have news of the fate of the evil-doers who have come up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
segments: The good man will be like a tall tree in his strength; his growth will be as the wide-stretching trees of Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 92:13
segments: Those who are planted in the house of the Lord will come up tall and strong in his gardens.

entries.title: Psalms 92:14
segments: They will give fruit even when they are old; they will be fertile and full of growth;

entries.title: Psalms 92:15
segments: For a sign that the Lord is upright; he is my Rock, there is no deceit in him.
